observations: The predicted SendWeaponAnim path calls HUD_SendWeaponAnim with the third argument (body) set to zero.
HUD_SendWeaponAnim forwards that body argument to the engine weapon-animation callback.
The inspected hardware renderer delegates bodygroup selection and mesh drawing to the engine studio API.
The approved shield viewmodel glass textures have flags=0; their transparency cannot be recovered from a texture alpha flag.
limits: The original client was not run.
The engine studio implementation and final framebuffer were not inspected.
No conclusion that the glass variant is never drawn or that a specific opacity matches CS 1.6 is established.
